name: Fushikitan Kyuukon Sennen Shoujo
original_name: 不死鬼譚 きゅうこん　千年少女
source:
Motoki belongs to the news club at Yuzuhara high school. One day, his kouhai Kaede confessed to him and he accepted it, becoming lovers. They started to investigate one of Yuzuhara-chou's seven mysteries, about the fenced fields, but the club leader Maki started to look like she was being possessed. A mysterious girl who thy met at the dam, Mitsuki, told them that it all stemmed from a bulb (kyuukon) that he had buried.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/08/01/august-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]

Fushikitan Kyuukon won a Judges' Special Award at Kinetic Novel Grand Prize 2010.
translation:
元树就读于柚原高中的新闻部。一天，他的后辈枫向他表白，他接受了，两人成为了恋人。他们开始调查柚原町七大不可思议之一——关于围栏田地的传说——但部长真纪开始看起来像是被附身了。他们在水坝遇到的神秘女孩美月告诉他们，这一切都源于他埋下的一个球根。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/08/01/august-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]

《不死鬼谭 球根 千年少女》在2010年Kinetic Novel大奖中获得了评委特别奖。
